spec.description:
Kingspan Kooltherm K12 Framing Board is an ultra-thin, fiber-free rigid
thermoset phenolic insulation board engineered for timber and steel frame walls,
masonry cavity walls, and concrete wall lining. With a super-low thermal
conductivity of 0.021 - 0.023 W/m·K, it delivers high thermal performance at
half the thickness of traditional bulk insulation batts, allowing homes to
reach 7-star NatHERS ratings within standard framing depths. Laminated with
composite foil facings on both sides, it minimizes thermal bridging and is fully
CodeMark certified.
features:
Super high thermal performance with thermal
conductivity of 0.021 - 0.023 W/m·K

Ultra-thin profile enables slimmer walls
and maximizes internal usable floor space

Solves 7-star NatHERS energy
compliance within standard 90mm timber and steel wall studs

Low-Rise
Insulated Wall Solution (Type C construction) replaces timber framing with
adhesive mounting

Composite foil facings on both sides increase thermal
resistance of unventilated cavities

Non-respirable, fiber-free closed-cell
phenolic core; resistant to moisture and sagging
Unaffected by air infiltration and resistant to water vapor
Locally manufactured in Victoria, Australia with zero ODP blowing agents
Global GreenTag GreenRate Level A certified with third-party verified EPD

install:
Cut boards to width to fit
tightly between framing studs or install continuously across framing face

For
friction-fit between studs, cut boards 5mm wider than opening and push firmly
into cavity

For continuous installation over framing, fasten with screws and
broad washers at 300mm perimeter centers

For Low-Rise Wall Solution on
concrete/masonry, apply Kooltherm K12 Adhesive in vertical beads and press board
to wall

Tape all board joints with 72mm reinforced aluminum foil tape to
maintain continuous vapor and thermal barrier

Maintain minimum 20mm still air
cavity where reflective air-space R-value is calculated
selection_checklist:
Confirm wall framing depth and target R-value
(e.g. 50mm R2.15, 80mm R3.45)

Verify building fire resistance construction
type (Class 1 housing or Type C construction in Class 2-9)

Determine fixing
method (between studs vs continuous over framing vs adhesive direct-fix)
Order matching 72mm reinforced foil tape and Kooltherm K12 Adhesive
accessories: Mechanical insulation fasteners with washer plates
limitations:
For
Class 2-9 buildings of Type A or B fire-resisting construction, a Performance
Solution is required

Must not be left exposed to direct weather without
protective wall wrap and cladding

retrieval.rag_summary:
Kingspan Kooltherm K12
Framing Board is an ultra-thin, fiber-free rigid thermoset phenolic insulation
board with dual composite foil facings, designed for timber, steel, and masonry
wall assemblies. Delivering a thermal conductivity of 0.021 - 0.023 W/m·K and
material ratings up to R4.35 (100mm), it allows builders to achieve 7-star
NatHERS energy efficiency within standard 90mm stud cavities without widening
footprints. CodeMark certified and manufactured in Australia with zero ODP
blowing agents, it provides continuous, non-slumping thermal efficiency for
modern building envelopes.
